cli_desc: Make an ebook cover image that meets self-publishing platform rules from a title, author and publisher. Run without options to open the GUI.
cli_inputs: Background image or EPUB file to open in the GUI
cli_publisher: Publisher name (required, placed at the bottom)
cli_preset: Size: upaper 800×1200, general 1600×2400, square 1200×1200, custom (default upaper)
cli_template: Template 1 centered, 2 bands, 3 vertical title, 4 translucent box (default 1)
cli_font: Font: sans body, sans_bold title, serif (default sans_bold)
cli_epub: EPUB to insert the cover into. Writes <name>_cover.epub
cli_format: File format jpg or png (default follows the -o extension)
cli_output: Output file (default cover.jpg). If it exists, cover(2).jpg
cli_help: show this help message and exit
